These three PNG fixtures are original synthetic solid-colour images (#385B49), generated locally with Windows System.Drawing. They contain no player skin, account data or third-party artwork.

- skin64.png:64x64 standard skin dimensions.
- skin-legacy.png:64x32 legacy skin dimensions.
- skin-unsupported.png:32x32, intentionally unsupported dimensions.

Tests obtain model metadata and identities from separate synthetic provider responses. No live player identity is queried to construct these fixtures.
